tasks.short: Confer with IT on genetic analysis applications.

steps.what: Retrieve actual genetic analysis requirements, data examples and existing application interface documentation
inputs: actual genetic analysis question and existing software
actual representative datasets and interface records
outputs: checked actual application discussion sources

steps.what: Confer with information technology specialists to develop genetic data analysis applications
inputs: checked actual application discussion sources
actual IT questions and scientific constraints
outputs: actual agreed scientific requirements and unresolved application issues

steps.what: Record and check actual agreed genetic application requirements and intended IT recipients
inputs: actual agreed scientific requirements and unresolved application issues
outputs: checked final actual application requirement record and recipients

steps.what: Save the checked actual genetic application requirement record
inputs: checked final actual application requirement record and recipients
outputs: saved actual genetic application requirements

steps.what: Send exact checked scientific application requirements to actual IT collaborators
inputs: checked final actual application requirement record and recipients
outputs: delivered actual scientific application requirements

tasks.design: Configure native source/interface links in {DOCS}, {PROJECT} and genetic analysis software {OTHER}. The geneticist retains scientific clarification and actual IT discussion, captures/checks agreed requirements and separately saves and delivers them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Application discussion can repeat source/interface navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked requirements and source documentation can shorten preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Translating genetic analysis needs into correct software behaviour requires direct collaboration.
tasks.human_edge: The geneticist identifies an implementation assumption that changes scientific meaning.
tasks.altitude: Less discussion preparation; scientific collaboration stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source/interface links can support application discussions; they do not supply scientific requirements or develop a correct application.

assumptions: Actual project/software owners supply source/interface records and geneticist checks them in s1. Actual scientific requirements are elicited during s2 and captured/checked in s3; no free structured specification.
Only repeated source navigation loses time. Actual discussion, decision, requirement capture and final check remain retained. IT development labour is outside focal geneticist saving.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native links first; existing access earns zero saving. Actual written record/delivery branches only; oral-only cases remove them and reweight. Save/send each retain one percent using existing final check.
research_questions: Can native links reduce preparation while preserving scientific clarification?

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual requirement record and exact project destination; edits require recheck
s3 checked final actual requirements and exact authorised IT recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 navigation = 6; minus 0.5 upkeep = 5.5. Half eligible gives 3 minus 0.5 = 2.5. Discussion, capture/check, save and send retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

actual collection locations, resources and permissions

steps.what: Coordinate actual field collection arrangements with collectors and site or specimen owners
inputs: actual chosen sampling design and specimen specifications
actual collector/site constraints and permissions
outputs: actual agreed sample collection arrangements and unresolved issues

steps.what: Prepare and check actual sampling plan, collection instructions and exact collector destinations
inputs: actual chosen sampling design and specimen specifications
actual agreed sample collection arrangements and unresolved issues

steps.what: Save the checked final actual sampling and collection plan
inputs: checked final actual sampling plan and collector instructions

tasks.design: Configure native study/sample references and instruction fields in {DOCS}, {PROJECT} and specimen management software {OTHER}. The geneticist retains sampling design and field coordination, captures actual arrangements and checks the exact final plan before separate save and delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sampling work can repeat source navigation and stable study/specimen references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and instruction fields can reduce duplicate navigation/entry.
tasks.still_hard: Representativeness and feasible specimen collection need scientific and field judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The geneticist detects a collection plan that would bias the sample or compromise specimens.
tasks.altitude: Less plan administration; sampling judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native study/sample references and instruction fields can support sampling administration; they do not design representative sampling or establish collection permission.

assumptions: Actual study/site owners supply objectives, specimen requirements and actual permissions; geneticist checks these in s1. Actual sample design and collector/site agreement remain fully retained in s2/s3.

S4 reduces repeated study/specimen identifiers and stable instruction headings only; actual new arrangements and full check remain within retained 14.4 hours. Planned collection does not imply collected specimens.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Design and coordination are alternative actual branches; reweight actual work. Native fields first; existing automated references earn zero saving.

Save/send each retain one percent using existing final check after instructions exist. Actual collection requires actual authorised owners and consent/permissions; no new intervention authority or avoided collection labour is assumed.
research_questions: Can native fields reduce plan entry after full scientific and collection checks?

already_counted.description: Capture actual sampling arrangements and check final instructions in s4.

incremental.description: Maintain actual study/sample links and instruction fields.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual sampling plan and exact study destination; edits require recheck
s4 checked final actual collection instructions and exact authorised collectors; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 navigation + 18*0.20 repeated fields = 9.6; minus 1 upkeep = 8.6. Half eligible gives 4.8 minus 1 = 3.8. Sampling design, coordination, actual capture/check and actions retained.

tasks.short: Evaluate, diagnose or treat genetic diseases.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual patient history, genetic test results and relevant clinical records
inputs: actual patient identity
actual clinical history and genetic test reports with source dates
outputs: checked actual genetic clinical context

steps.what: Evaluate and diagnose actual genetic diseases and choose patient-specific care where indicated
inputs: checked actual genetic clinical context
actual patient examination, account and clinical discussion
outputs: actual clinical findings, diagnosis and final care decision

steps.what: Treat actual genetic disease within actual clinical authority and assess patient response
inputs: actual clinical findings, diagnosis and final care decision
actual patient consent and required safety conditions
outputs: actual provided genetic-disease care and observed response

steps.what: Record and check actual clinical findings, genetic assessment, treatment and observed response
inputs: actual clinical findings, diagnosis and final care decision
actual provided genetic-disease care and observed response
outputs: checked final actual genetic clinical record

steps.what: Commit the checked actual genetic clinical record
inputs: checked final actual genetic clinical record
outputs: committed actual genetic-disease encounter record

tasks.design: Configure native patient/test source views in clinical record software {OTHER}. The geneticist retains actual evaluation, diagnosis, care and primary clinical capture, then fully checks and separately commits the actual encounter record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical work can repeat navigation among patient and genetic test records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native patient/test links can reduce retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical significance and patient-specific care require qualified judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The geneticist distinguishes an uncertain genetic result from a defensible clinical diagnosis.
tasks.altitude: Less clinical record navigation; genetic care stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native patient/test source links can support clinical retrieval; they do not diagnose genetic disease or confer treatment authority.

assumptions: Actual clinical/test owners supply patient identity, report version, result and date; geneticist verifies these in s1. Missing or conflicting reports remain manual. All evaluation, examination, diagnosis and actual clinical capture stay retained.

Evaluation, diagnosis and treatment are alternative actual branches. Remove unused treatment and reweight rather than inventing intervention. Actual clinical qualifications/authority and required consent/safety must hold before any care.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native views first; existing linked access earns zero saving. S3 gate is actual final care decision with safety conditions, not added self-approval work. Outcomes recorded only after actual care.

Actual prescriptions, referrals or orders each need their own exact-final-content gated action if present; no avoided order/send labour claimed here. Record commit retains one percent using existing final check.
research_questions: Can native views shorten retrieval while preserving full clinical interpretation?

approvals.approved_version: s2 actual final patient-specific care decision with actual clinical authority, consent and safety conditions; changes require reassessment
s4 checked final actual genetic clinical record and exact patient encounter; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 clinical navigation = 8; minus 0.5 upkeep = 7.5. Half eligible gives 4 minus 0.5 = 3.5. Evaluation, care, actual record capture/check and commit retained.

tasks.short: Study families to evaluate genetic bases of traits or diseases.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual permitted family medical records and existing pedigree sources
inputs: actual family study question and permitted participant records
actual existing family/pedigree documentation

steps.what: Conduct actual family medical study interviews, examinations and primary observation capture
inputs: checked actual family-study source context
actual participating family members and permitted study procedures
outputs: actual family history, observations and study measurements

steps.what: Evaluate actual genetic basis for traits or diseases using family study evidence
inputs: actual family history, observations and study measurements
checked actual family-study source context
outputs: actual genetic-family findings, uncertainty and limitations

steps.what: Record and check actual pedigree, family observations and genetic-study findings
inputs: actual family history, observations and study measurements
actual genetic-family findings, uncertainty and limitations
outputs: checked final actual family medical study record

inputs: checked final actual family medical study record

tasks.design: Configure native permitted family/source links in clinical research and pedigree software {OTHER}, with references in {DOCS}. The geneticist retains actual family study, primary history capture, interpretation and complete record checking before a separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Family-study preparation can repeat permitted-source navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source/family links can shorten retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Family observations and inheritance interpretation require careful actual study.
tasks.human_edge: The geneticist recognises uncertain family accounts and alternative explanations for a trait.
tasks.altitude: Less family-source navigation; genetic evaluation remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native permitted family/source links can support study retrieval; they do not establish kinship, genetic causation or permission to access another relative's records.

assumptions: Actual authorised record owners supply existing records and participant/source identity; geneticist checks scope in s1. Actual family interviews, examinations, primary observations and interpretation remain retained.

No automatic pedigree creation from unverified accounts or free family-history capture is assumed. Record entry and full final checking remain in s4; missing relatives/evidence remain explicitly uncertain.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native permitted links first; existing linked access and computational runtime earn zero saving. Actual participant permission and study authority must hold; no external family disclosure is assumed.
Routine commit retains one percent using existing final check. Any actual clinical advice/report delivery must be its own exact-final-version gated action; no avoided send labour claimed here.
research_questions: Can native links shorten retrieval while preserving full family study and uncertainty checks?

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual family study record and exact authorised study/participant destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 source navigation = 4; minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Half eligible gives 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5. Actual study, interpretation, record capture/check and commit retained.

role.altitude: Geneticists retain scientific and clinical judgement while actual source navigation and stable instruction fields may shrink.
